feature.name: vault-resolution-override
feature.summary: Add a human-correctable override tier (with a pass-through slot for a future metadata tier) that takes priority over the live Terragrunt resolver, letting users fix vaults the parser cannot resolve directly from the Secrets page.

acceptance_criteria: Setting an override for a vaultDir persists across a page reload and is reflected in the next resolveKeyVaults() call within one 60s cache TTL window
resolveKeyVaults() checks overrides[vaultDir] before invoking terragruntLocalsResolver; when an override exists, the live resolver is never called for that vault
resolveVaultNameWithFallback() applies priority override > metadata > live and returns { name, resourceGroup, source }

resolveKeyVaults() always calls the helper with metadata: undefined in this PRD's scope; a missing/absent metadata argument (and, in the future Phase B shape, a missing metadata.keyvaults field) is treated as a normal no-op fall-through to the live resolver, never as an error

POST /api/secrets/vault-name-override rejects the write with a 4xx response (including correlationId) if the submitted vaultDir is not among the vaults discovered by resolveKeyVaults()/matchVaultsFromEntries for the given appName/environment/target/qualifier
A sha conflict on the sidecar write returns a non-2xx response with correlationId; the write is never silently lost or overwritten without a fresh read
loadVaultOverrides() always reads/writes config.github.serviceRepo regardless of the target value passed to resolveKeyVaults(), and never calls mapRepo(target)
Every resolveKeyVaults() invocation emits exactly one correlationId-prefixed logger.debug line per vault naming vaultDir and source
Vaults with no override and no metadata entry resolve identically to pre-feature behavior (tier 3, live resolver only)
The 'Set name manually' control appears only for vaults whose vaultName is null/falsy, and on successful submission the vault list is refetched without a full page reload

A missing/absent metadata.keyvaults field is treated as a normal no-op fall-through, not an error requiring Phase B implementation here

keyvault_override_sidecar.location: docs/overrides/keyvault-overrides.json in config.github.serviceRepo (organization/service-catalog), read/written via githubService.getFileContent()/createOrUpdateFile() using githubService.octokit only

<vaultDir>.name: string - corrected Key Vault name
<vaultDir>.appName: string - display/audit only, never part of the lookup key
<vaultDir>.environment: string - display/audit only, never part of the lookup key
<vaultDir>.qualifier: string (optional) - display/audit only, never part of the lookup key
<vaultDir>.verifiedBy: string - user identity who submitted the override

validation: Keyed by the exact vaultDir string used elsewhere in secretsService/terragruntLocalsResolver — no new derivation/normalization logic
File is created lazily on first override write; does not need to pre-exist
A malformed or missing sidecar file causes loadVaultOverrides() to return an empty override set (not an error)
Repeat submission for an existing vaultDir key overwrites that entry

DELIBERATE DEVIATION from submitSecretViaGitOps' branch+PR GitOps pattern: writes commit directly to the service-catalog repo's default branch (defaultBranch = process.env.SERVICE_CATALOG_BRANCH || 'main', the same default githubService.getFileContent() already uses) via githubService.createOrUpdateFile(serviceRepo, defaultBranch, path, content, message, sha) - no feature branch is created and no PR is opened. Justification: (1) PRD Goal 1's success metric requires the override to be reflected in the next resolveKeyVaults() call within one 60s cache TTL window, which a PR-gated write cannot satisfy since the file only changes on merge; (2) this is a display-only correction to a new, dedicated sidecar path, not a Terraform/infrastructure change subject to the branch+PR/CODEOWNERS review gate that protects docs/metadata/* and Terraform modules; (3) write safety is still enforced via the same sha-based optimistic-concurrency check submitSecretViaGitOps() uses (409 on stale sha) - only the branch-creation/PR steps are omitted, not the concurrency guard.

docs/overrides/ requires no new CODEOWNERS entry in service-catalog: it is a new, dedicated path distinct from docs/metadata/* and Terraform modules, so no existing reviewer group's approval gate is bypassed by this direct-commit pattern; tracked as an assumption alongside the PRD's existing assumption that githubService.octokit already has write access to docs/ in the service-catalog repo (PRD Section 10)

resolve_vault_name_with_fallback_result.location: in-memory return value of resolveVaultNameWithFallback(vaultEntry, overrides, metadata) in services/secretsService.js
validation: When overrides[vaultDir] exists, source is 'override' and the live resolver is not invoked

metadata is always undefined when called from resolveKeyVaults() in this PRD's scope; a missing metadata argument is a normal no-op, falling through to live resolution unchanged from pre-feature behavior
When neither override nor live resolution produce a name, source is 'unresolved' and name is null

flows.name: Vault name resolution with override tier
steps: resolveKeyVaults() enumerates candidate vaults for appName/environment/target/qualifier
For each vault, resolveVaultNameWithFallback(vaultEntry, overrides, metadata=undefined) is called
If overrides[vaultDir] exists, that value is returned with source='override' and the live resolver is skipped
Otherwise (metadata always undefined in this scope), terragruntLocalsResolver.resolveName()/resolveResourceGroup() are called as today
One correlationId-prefixed logger.debug line is emitted per vault naming vaultDir and source
resolveKeyVaults() returns vaults with vaultName/resourceGroup populated as before

error_paths.error: loadVaultOverrides() sidecar read fails or file missing
error_paths.handling: returns empty override set; resolution falls through to live resolver unchanged

error_paths.error: live resolver throws or returns null
error_paths.handling: source='unresolved', name=null, caller's existing 'Key Vault name unavailable' UI path preserved

flows.name: Override submission
steps: User submits corrected name via SecretsPage.vue inline form
POST /api/secrets/vault-name-override validates request fields
Endpoint calls resolveKeyVaults()/matchVaultsFromEntries to confirm vaultDir is a real discovered vault

Endpoint reads docs/overrides/keyvault-overrides.json (current content + sha) via githubService.getFileContent(serviceRepo, path, defaultBranch), where defaultBranch = process.env.SERVICE_CATALOG_BRANCH || 'main'

Endpoint merges/overwrites the entry keyed by vaultDir and commits directly to defaultBranch via githubService.createOrUpdateFile(serviceRepo, defaultBranch, path, content, message, sha) - a deliberate deviation from submitSecretViaGitOps' branch+PR pattern (see data_contracts.keyvault_override_sidecar.validation for rationale); no branch is created and no PR is opened
Endpoint responds { success, data, correlationId }
Frontend refetches the vault list; corrected name appears without a full page reload

error_paths.handling: 400 response with field errors and correlationId
422 response with correlationId; write is not attempted
409 response with correlationId; client may retry with a fresh read

error_scenarios.scenario: Sidecar file docs/overrides/keyvault-overrides.json does not exist yet
error_scenarios.handling: loadVaultOverrides() treats a 404 from getFileContent() as an empty override set; resolution falls through to live resolver
error_scenarios.user_message: No override exists for this vault; existing 'Key Vault name unavailable' behavior is unchanged
error_scenarios.logging: No error logged; treated as a normal, expected state on first use

error_scenarios.scenario: Sidecar file content is malformed JSON
error_scenarios.handling: loadVaultOverrides() catches the parse error and returns an empty override set rather than throwing
error_scenarios.user_message: Resolution silently falls through to the live resolver for all vaults
error_scenarios.logging: Warning logged with correlationId noting the parse failure, without failing the resolution call

error_scenarios.scenario: Client submits a vaultDir that resolveKeyVaults() does not discover for the given appName/environment/target/qualifier
error_scenarios.handling: Endpoint rejects the write with 422 before any GitHub call is made
error_scenarios.user_message: vaultDir does not match a discovered vault
error_scenarios.logging: Logged with correlationId, appName, environment, target, and the rejected vaultDir

error_scenarios.scenario: Concurrent override writes race on the same sidecar file
error_scenarios.handling: createOrUpdateFile() is called with the sha read moments earlier; GitHub rejects a stale sha with a 409-class error which the endpoint surfaces as a non-2xx response
error_scenarios.user_message: Override file was modified concurrently; retry the request
error_scenarios.logging: Logged with correlationId; zero data loss since the concurrent edit is preserved and the client's write is rejected, not merged blindly

error_scenarios.scenario: metadata argument (or future metadata.keyvaults field) is missing/undefined
error_scenarios.handling: resolveVaultNameWithFallback() treats this as a normal no-op and falls through to the next tier (live) — never throws, never logs as an error
error_scenarios.user_message: n/a — invisible to the user; resolution proceeds via override or live tier
error_scenarios.logging: No error or warning logged for this case; it is the expected, common path in this PRD's scope

error_scenarios.scenario: requireAuth rejects an unauthenticated request to POST /api/secrets/vault-name-override
error_scenarios.handling: Standard 401 handled by existing requireAuth middleware, unchanged from other /api/secrets/* routes
error_scenarios.logging: Handled by existing auth middleware logging convention

performance.override_sidecar_fetch_frequency: at most once per 60-second window per process (cache hit rate >= 99% of resolveKeyVaults() calls within a TTL window, no concurrent stampede)
performance.api_response_time: <500ms for POST /api/secrets/vault-name-override (95th percentile), consistent with existing /api/secrets/* endpoints

security: POST /api/secrets/vault-name-override uses requireAuth — same policy as all other /api/secrets/* routes, zero new role/permission model
100% of endpoint inputs validated via express-validator before any GitHub write
No new Octokit client/credential introduced; reuses githubService.octokit (Infrastructure App) only
reliability: 100% of write conflicts (stale sha) surfaced to the caller as a non-2xx response rather than silently overwriting a concurrent edit
Zero data-loss incidents in the override file across concurrent submissions
A malformed or missing sidecar file never causes resolveKeyVaults() to error; it falls through to the live resolver

scale.concurrent_override_writes: sha-based optimistic concurrency handles concurrent submissions without data loss
scale.github_api_calls: override tier adds at most 1 GitHub read per 60s window per process, well within the existing <5000/hour budget
